parameters.text:
=Clean up the Student data based on the below conditions

Row data: {{ JSON.stringify($json) }}

Rules:
- Name: All in uppercase (MANOJ K)
- Email: if invalid set INVALID_EMAIL
- Phone: if less than 10 digits set ERROR-UPDATE
- Course: only Python or Machine Learning or Data Science
- Fee_Paid: yes/YES = TRUE, no/NO = FALSE
- City: UpperCase, empty = UNKNOWN
- Enrolled_Date: convert to YYYY-MMM-DD
Return ONLY raw JSON. No explanation. No markdown.
